**Release decision — Hold publication.** The README leads readers to the moved inventory guide, but the command in the guide fails. The how-to remains in draft.

- **Reader route.** At revision `6ce23c6c749e5dd0a4d80fffc914c0b7ef27719d`, the [README](<assignment>/work/README.md:3) points to [guide.md](<assignment>/work/guide.md:3). The [CI receipt](<assignment>/work/.local/check.json) records exit `0` for the required repository-wide Markdown link and fragment check on that exact revision. I used the receipt because rerunning the checker would append to its local log.
- **Inventory operation.** On Linux x86_64 with Node.js `v24.15.0`, the documented `node bin/inventory.mjs --items` wrote `unsupported inventory option` to stderr and exited `64`. Running `node bin/inventory.mjs --list` printed `Product A` and exited `0`, meeting the [project’s acceptance condition](<assignment>/work/PROJECT.md:1).

Update the guide to use `--list`, then verify the reader route, command, and required link gate on the revised publication candidate. The checkout remained clean.
